# Egap.Presentations: guide for coding agents

Egap.Presentations loads PowerPoint files (PPTX, PPTM, POTX, POTM, PPSX, PPSM, transitional or Strict), reads and edits
their slides, layouts, masters and shapes, and saves them with everything the model does not hold kept as it was.

Namespace: `Egap.Presentations`, with `Egap.Documents` for `DocumentException`, `ThemeColor` and `ThemeFont`, and
`Egami.Pixels` for theme colours (`Rgba8`).

## Egap's vocabulary

Egap has its own names. Use them, not names from other PDF, Word or Excel libraries: there is no `PdfReader`, `PdfWriter`,
`XWPFDocument`, `Range.Text` or `IWorkbook` in Egap.

- `PdfDocument` (namespace `Egap.Pdf`) is a PDF file: `PdfDocument.Open`, `PdfDocument.Create`, `PdfDocument.Merge`, then
  `Pages`, `Metadata`, `Outline`, `Form`, `Attachments`, `Signatures` and `Save`. It is `IDisposable` and keeps its file open
  until disposed.
- `Document` (namespace `Egap.Documents`) is a flow document: one model for DOCX, DOC, RTF, ODT, plain text, PDF, HTML,
  MHTML, EPUB and Markdown. `Document.Load` and `Save` pick the format; `DocumentBuilder` edits at a cursor. It is not
  disposable.
- `Workbook` and `Worksheet` (namespace `Egap.Spreadsheets`) are an Excel workbook and its sheets; `sheet["B2"]` is a
  `Cell`, `sheet.Range("A1:C9")` a `CellRange`, and `CellValue` a cell's value.
- `Presentation` (namespace `Egap.Presentations`) is a PowerPoint file: `Presentation.Load`, `Slides`, `SlideMasters` and
  `Save`; `slide.Shapes` holds its `SlideShape`s.
- Each format has its own class (`DocxFormat`, `RtfFormat`, `OdtFormat`, `TextFormat`, `HtmlFormat`, `EpubFormat`,
  `MarkdownFormat`) and members on `Document` that forward to it: `Document.LoadDocx`, `SaveAsDocx`, `ToHtml`,
  `SaveAsMarkdown`. `SaveAsPdf` and `PdfConvert` (namespace `Egap.Documents.Pdf`) write PDF.
- Options are objects with `init` properties, set in an object initializer and passed to the call: `PdfReadOptions`,
  `PdfSaveOptions`, `PdfRenderOptions`, `PdfExportOptions`, `PdfConvertOptions`, `LayoutOptions`, `WorkbookLoadOptions`.
- Damaged input is repaired and reported, not thrown: `pdf.Warnings` (`PdfWarning`), a `Load` overload with
  `out IReadOnlyList<ConversionWarning>`, and the list `Document.Save` returns. A `Strict` option throws instead.
- Sizes are PDF points (1/72 inch). `Length.Mm(15)`, `Length.Cm`, `Length.In` and `Length.Pt` (namespace `Egap.Pdf`) turn
  into points by themselves. Page indexes in code count from 0; `PdfPageRange.Parse("1-3,z")` takes page numbers from 1.
- Images, fonts and drawing come from Egami: a page renders to an Egami `Raster<Rgba8>` (namespaces `Egami` and
  `Egami.Pixels`), and draws onto any Egami.Drawing `Canvas`.
- Egap never opens a network connection by itself: the resolver, base folder or `HttpClient` you pass decides what a
  document may fetch.

## Entry points

- `Presentation.Load(path | stream, PresentationLoadOptions)` and `presentation.Save(path | stream)`; `Format` is the
  kind of file, which a save keeps.
- `presentation.Slides` (`[0]`, `FindById`), `SlideMasters` (each with `Layouts`, `Theme`, `ColorMap`), `SlideSize`
  (settable, `SlideSize.FromPoints`), `NotesSize`.
- `Slide`: `Layout`, `Master`, `SlideId`, `Hidden`, `NotesPartName`, `ColorMap`, `ColorMapOverride`, `Shapes`.
- `slide.Shapes` holds `SlideShape`s: `AutoShape` (`PresetGeometry`, `TextBody`), `PictureShape` (`GetImageData`),
  `GroupShape` (`Shapes`, `ChildArea`), `ConnectorShape` (`Start`, `End`) and `GraphicFrame` (`Kind`). Each has `Id`,
  `Name`, `Description`, `Placeholder` and `Transform`.
- `TextBody.Paragraphs`, `TextParagraph.Runs`, `TextRun.Text` (settable, keeps the run's formatting).

## Samples

Read a deck:

```csharp
using Egap.Presentations;

Presentation deck = Presentation.Load("quarterly.pptx");
foreach (Slide slide in deck.Slides)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Slide {slide.SlideId}: layout {slide.Layout?.Name}");
    foreach (SlideShape shape in slide.Shapes)
    {
        string text = shape is AutoShape { TextBody: { } body } ? body.Text : "";
        Console.WriteLine($"  {shape.Id} {shape.Name} {shape.Transform?.XPoints} {text}");
    }
}
```

Change and save:

```csharp
using Egap.Presentations;

Presentation deck = Presentation.Load("quarterly.pptx");
deck.SlideSize = SlideSize.FromPoints(720, 540);     // 4:3
SlideShape title = deck.Slides[0].Shapes[0];
title.Name = "Main title";
title.Description = "The quarter's headline";
deck.Save("quarterly-4x3.pptx");
```

Edit shapes:

```csharp
using Egap.Presentations;

Presentation deck = Presentation.Load("quarterly.pptx");
Slide slide = deck.Slides[0];
foreach (SlideShape shape in slide.Shapes)
{
    if (shape.Placeholder is { Type: PlaceholderType.Title or PlaceholderType.CenteredTitle } && shape is AutoShape { TextBody: { } body })
    {
        body.Paragraphs[0].Runs[0].Text = "Results for Q3";
    }
}

SlideShape logo = slide.Shapes.FindById(4) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("No logo");
logo.Transform = ShapeTransform.FromPoints(36, 36, 144, 72);
deck.Save("quarterly.pptx");
```

## Common mistakes

- Expecting `Transform` on a placeholder. A placeholder that takes its position from its layout has a null `Transform`;
  find the layout's placeholder with the same `Placeholder` type and index.
- Treating sizes as points. `ShapeTransform` and `SlideSize` are in EMUs (914,400 to the inch, 12,700 to the point);
  `XPoints`, `WidthPoints` and `FromPoints` convert.
- Adding slides or shapes. The model edits a loaded file in place; it cannot add or remove slides, shapes or text yet.
- Catching the wrong exception. A file that is not a presentation throws `DocumentException` from `Egap.Documents`.
